title: Corneal Stability following Hyperopic LASIK with Advanced Laser Ablation Profiles Analyzed by a Light Propagation Study
indication: hyperopia +0.50 to +8.50 D and/or hyperopic astigmatism up to 4.75 D (eligibility); right eye of each patient; cohort restricted to eyes with 12-month follow-up

groups.description: Group 1, preoperative SE of 3 D or less (as defined in Methods); femtosecond LASIK (60 kHz IntraLase flap, Schwind Amaris, optimized aspheric aberration-free profile)
Group 2, preoperative SE above 3 D (as defined in Methods); femtosecond LASIK (60 kHz IntraLase flap, Schwind Amaris, optimized aspheric aberration-free profile)

exclusions.reason: whole cohort; its two preoperative-SE subgroups (tab2, tab3) are extracted instead

exclusions.what: Fig. 3 (efficacy, safety, predictability, refractive change plots)
exclusions.reason: plots and proportions are not admissible

notes: Target recorded plano: the planned correction was the manifest refraction (patients older than 40) or the manifest refraction plus 50% of the manifest-cycloplegic difference (younger than 40) to offset latent hyperopia; no non-plano target is described.

Method unstated: the Results state the range of the preoperative cycloplegic SE, which is the range printed in tab1!R8C2, so the tabulated preoperative SE appears to be cycloplegic; postoperative refraction is described only as subjective refraction.
The SE used for the group cut-off is not identified exactly: the printed preoperative SE range of group 2 (tab3!R8C2) includes values not above the stated cut-off.
Preoperative exclusion criteria list previous corneal surgery and retouch of refractive surgery.
Visual acuity, sphere, cylinder and objective corneal power are tabulated but not extracted.

series.notes: mean ± SD (range) per footnote, range not used; n from the table header; no attrition (cohort restricted to eyes with 12-month follow-up)
